protocol: Four modes: baseline/current, default-off/opt-in. Both versions receive the same current-workspace cached RGB-derived features and matches; no decode, extraction, GPU or dense stage. Cached guided matches may contain prior geometric selection: no claim of a fresh calibration-independent RGB front end. Five known-K rows supply COLMAP K/distortion explicitly; the two shared-focal rows use centered principal point, square pixels and zero distortion assumptions. No reference poses/depths enter reconstruction, and the added estimated-focal row does not receive COLMAP K. No masks are used. One sequential pass per mode; elapsedMs times reconstruction only, excluding hashing/alignment; diagnostic, not a speed comparison. COLMAP reference poses are estimates, used only in evaluation. One similarity alignment per whole connected map, with missing registrations retained in the report. Reference agreement and Pyramid relief do not establish ground-truth accuracy. This is not the full current Pyramid catalogue video. Across-version comparisons measure integration changes; within-version off/on comparisons isolate the directional flag under that version.
